meta.description: Add WhatsApp Business Cloud API channel via Chat SDK. Official Meta API.

copy.tagline: 用 Chat SDK 接入 WhatsApp 官方消息通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发需要接入 WhatsApp 消息的应用。
copy.tagline_en: Add WhatsApp Business Cloud API channel via Chat SDK
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building a chat app that needs WhatsApp messaging.

howto.what: 装上该技能后,Claude 会按步骤给 NanoClaw 加一个只支持一对一私聊的 whatsapp-cloud 频道:复制并登记 WhatsApp 连接代码、安装固定版本依赖、把四项 Meta 凭据写入 .env、跑构建和测试;配好 Meta 后台 webhook 后就能收发 WhatsApp 消息,还可用 /manage-channels 把它接到智能体群组。
howto.when: 当你说要给 NanoClaw 接入 WhatsApp Cloud API、新建或升级 whatsapp-cloud 频道,或继续 /setup 流程时触发。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 接入 WhatsApp Cloud API 频道。
say.note: 会复制并登记连接代码,再构建和测试。

say.text: 把现有 WhatsApp 频道升级成 whatsapp-cloud。
say.note: 会把 Webhook 路径与订阅状态迁移到新实例。

say.text: 用我给的 Meta 凭据把频道配好。

howto.what_en: Running it adds a 1:1 `whatsapp-cloud` channel: copies/registers the adapter, installs the pinned dependency, saves Meta credentials, and builds/tests. It then handles WhatsApp messages; `/manage-channels` wires it to an agent group.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add WhatsApp Cloud API to NanoClaw, to create or upgrade the `whatsapp-cloud` channel, or to continue an unfinished `/setup` flow.

say_en.text: Add the WhatsApp Cloud API channel to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Copies and registers the adapter, then builds/tests.

say_en.text: Upgrade my existing WhatsApp setup to whatsapp-cloud.
say_en.note: Moves the webhook route and re-keys subscriptions.

say_en.text: Set up the channel with my Meta credentials.
say_en.note: Prompts for four Meta credentials and saves them to `.env`.
